journey_name: Landing page communicates the offer and exposes the primary CTA
plain_english_steps: Visitor loads the homepage, reads the promise, and can start the purchase flow from the primary CTA.
expected_outcome: Visitor understands the offer and can start checkout without confusion
notes: This is the public shell contract.

journey_name: Public crawl surface and homepage schema stay truthful
plain_english_steps: Crawler or visitor can read robots, sitemap, and truthful homepage structured data.
expected_outcome: Public discovery surface remains indexable and honest
notes: Keep schema aligned with visible sections.

journey_name: Docs pages stay canonical and indexable
plain_english_steps: Visitor opens a docs page and sees the canonical metadata rather than a noindex dead end.
expected_outcome: Docs help content is discoverable and correctly tagged
notes: Docs are not part of the default ship pack.

journey_name: Identity recovery preserves the intended destination after payment or protected-route access
preconditions: User is either returning from checkout or opening a protected route while signed out
plain_english_steps: Visitor signs in or finishes the post-payment identity flow and is returned to the protected destination they originally requested.
expected_outcome: Identity recovery never drops the requested destination or the post-payment handoff
notes: Local-auth browser proof now signs an entitled user into the canonical blueprint route flow and confirms the redirect target is preserved.

journey_name: Signed-out protected route access redirects safely to sign-in
preconditions: Protected route is requested without a session
plain_english_steps: Visitor opens a protected route while signed out and is sent to sign-in with a safe return path.
expected_outcome: Visitor never lands on a broken protected shell
notes: Canonical browser proof now enters /blueprint directly and runs in the @default_ship sandbox pack.

journey_name: No-access member sees inline recovery and guarded pending-checkout claim guidance
preconditions: Member can sign in but lacks entitlement
plain_english_steps: Signed-in member enters the protected workspace without access, sees recovery actions plus status guidance, and can recover a lost Stripe return tab through the guarded fallback claim when this browser still carries the pending checkout session.
expected_outcome: Member can recover or buy access without guessing
notes: Canonical browser proof now checks the canonical blueprint entry route.

journey_name: Checkout success offers post-payment sign-in or locked-email account creation
preconditions: Checkout success page is opened from a paid guest checkout or a broken success URL
plain_english_steps: Buyer lands on checkout success, sees a truthful recovery state, and can either sign in or create the account tied to the Stripe checkout email before the handoff continues.
expected_outcome: Member can recover the paid handoff without confusion or a blank state
notes: This recovery surface is release-critical even when billing is not re-run.

journey_name: Entitled member lands on `/blueprint` and sees the combined intake surface
plain_english_steps: Entitled member opens the workspace, sees the overview and welcome video, and gets one primary `Continue to Review` action at the bottom of the combined page.
expected_outcome: The blueprint funnel begins on `/blueprint` without detours or fake stage shells
notes: Canonical browser proof should land on `/blueprint` and keep the one-page intake truthful.

journey_name: Foundation and problem sections stay on the combined blueprint page
plain_english_steps: Member fills the foundation and problem sections on the same page, types without premature validation, and uses the shared Continue action to save partial work.
expected_outcome: The combined blueprint page keeps the required foundation/problem contract and Continue-only save feedback
notes: Integration coverage now proves the combined intake instead of the old routed stage shell.

journey_name: Design inputs live inside the combined blueprint page
plain_english_steps: Member completes the design section inside the combined blueprint page without leaving the canonical route.
expected_outcome: Design input remains part of the canonical blueprint contract without a separate route shell
notes: The old `/design` route now exists only as a compatibility redirect into `/blueprint#design`.

journey_name: Generated preview stays compiler-owned inside the combined blueprint page
plain_english_steps: Member reaches the generated preview section on the combined blueprint page and reviews the compiler-owned marketing defaults without filling another form.
expected_outcome: Marketing remains a compiler-owned preview section inside the canonical blueprint page
notes: The generated preview is now part of the single-page blueprint contract rather than a separate route.

journey_name: Pricing and setup live inside the combined blueprint page
plain_english_steps: Member captures pricing and optional setup details on the combined blueprint page and keeps the manual-save flow intact.
expected_outcome: Pricing and setup remain canonical inputs inside the single-page blueprint surface
notes: The one-page blueprint flow now owns pricing and setup directly.

journey_name: Review keeps the Blueprint primary and delays Execute / Ship
plain_english_steps: Member advances into Review, sees the Blueprint as the primary outcome, downloads it, and only then gets the full Execute / Ship branch.
expected_outcome: Review remains the download and ship handoff stage without letting the optional branch compete too early
notes: Canonical browser proof now checks `/review` and the full-repo download action while integration coverage proves the new Review hierarchy.

journey_name: Entitled member can traverse the full `/blueprint` to `/review` funnel
preconditions: Entitled member can sign in and stay in the workspace
plain_english_steps: Member moves through the combined blueprint page, resolves blockers, continues into Review, and downloads the Blueprint without route confusion or lock-state regressions.
expected_outcome: The blueprint-first funnel feels continuous end to end across `/blueprint` and `/review`
notes: The @default_ship sandbox pack now follows the canonical `/blueprint` plus `/review` contract directly.

journey_name: Post-review bonus library routes stay coherent before and after unlock
preconditions: Member has access to the blueprint-first app and may or may not have unlocked the optional bonus branch
plain_english_steps: Member opens `/mission` or `/lesson/<lessonKey>` and either sees explicit locked-bonus messaging before unlock or the restored post-review bonus library and video-first lesson route after unlock.
expected_outcome: The restored compatibility routes remain safe, truthful, and separate from the required blueprint funnel
notes: This row now tracks the restored post-review library behavior and still needs browser evidence for ship-grade confidence.

journey_name: Locked review entry redirects back to the canonical blueprint surface
preconditions: Member has not completed every required blueprint answer
plain_english_steps: Member opens Review directly and is routed back to `/blueprint` instead of seeing an invalid shell or stale intermediate route.
expected_outcome: Review gating stays truthful even when users deep-link into Review too early
notes: This is separate from the happy path because it proves redirect behavior rather than normal progression.

journey_name: Settings loads account and connection tools
plain_english_steps: Entitled member opens Settings and can manage account plus connection tools.
expected_outcome: Settings is reachable and useful from the protected workspace
notes: Default ship now includes a canonical sandbox check for /settings.

journey_name: Settings exposes starter repo and Codex connection add-ons

expected_outcome: Settings add-ons remain coherent after product changes

journey_name: Execute / Ship stays optional and opens a two-path bridge after unlock
preconditions: Entitled member has reached Review, requested the Blueprint download, and triggered the optional continue action
plain_english_steps: Member unlocks Execute / Ship from Review, opens the bridge page, can continue directly into Build at lesson `3.1` or start from the beginning at lesson `1.1`, and repeat visits to `/execute` send them to `/mission` after any bonus lesson has been opened.
expected_outcome: The optional execution bridge stays reachable and truthful without turning into another required blueprint stage
notes: This scenario is adjacent to Review but remains its own optional post-download branch.

journey_name: Visitor can start Stripe checkout directly from the public CTA

plain_english_steps: Visitor clicks the public CTA and reaches Stripe checkout in a safe test environment without a forced pre-payment sign-in detour.
expected_outcome: Checkout launch remains intact for a buy-first visitor
notes: Do not run this in an unsafe environment.

journey_name: Successful paid guest handoff grants access and lands in the funnel
preconditions: Safe billing test environment is available
plain_english_steps: Buyer completes a safe test payment while signed out, returns to checkout success, signs in or creates the account tied to the checkout email, claims the purchase, and enters the blueprint workspace.
expected_outcome: Paid handoff ends in access granted rather than a dead end
notes: Canonical billing browser proof now waits for `/blueprint` after checkout success and the post-payment claim.

journey_name: Starter repo access workflow remains usable

expected_outcome: Starter repo operations do not silently regress
notes: This stays in the extended pack.

journey_name: Codex connection surfaces and API routes stay available
plain_english_steps: Entitled member can inspect Codex connection state and the related API surface still behaves correctly.
expected_outcome: Codex connection remains a working extension surface
notes: This is extended because it does not gate the blueprint funnel.
